in_marathi.name: Lambodar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Hands
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lambodar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known as Lambodar, meaning ‘Lord of the Hands’. This name is derived from the Sanskrit term ‘lambodara’, which translates to ‘having large hands’. This name symbolizes the divine power and grace bestowed upon those who bear this name.
